title: Tiger cub dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='28' ry='5' fill='#2a1a4a' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 68 Q85 60 82 45 Q80 38 75 40 Q72 42 75 48 Q78 56 68 62' 
        fill='#FF8C00' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='2'/>
  <path d='M78 45 Q76 43 74 46' stroke='#CC5500' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M80 52 Q77 50 76 53' stroke='#CC5500' stroke-width='3' fill='none'/>
  
  <!-- left leg (raised, dancing) -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='82' rx='8' ry='12' fill='#FF8C00' transform='rotate(-20 35 82)'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='90' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#FFD700' transform='rotate(-20 32 90)'/>
  
  <!-- right leg (standing) -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='84' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#FF8C00' transform='rotate(10 58 84)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='91' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#FFD700' transform='rotate(10 60 91)'/>
  
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='72' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#FFE4B5'/>
  
  <!-- body stripes -->
  <path d='M36 58 Q40 62 38 68' stroke='#CC5500' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M32 65 Q36 68 35 73' stroke='#CC5500' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 58 Q56 62 58 68' stroke='#CC5500' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 65 Q60 68 61 73' stroke='#CC5500' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- left arm (waving up) -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='58' rx='7' ry='13' fill='#FF8C00' transform='rotate(40 28 58)'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='50' r='6' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='50' r='4' fill='#FFE4B5'/>
  
  <!-- right arm (out to side) -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='62' rx='7' ry='13' fill='#FF8C00' transform='rotate(-50 70 62)'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='56' r='6' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='56' r='4' fill='#FFE4B5'/>
  
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='38' rx='21' ry='19' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='24' r='7' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='24' r='4' fill='#FFB347'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='24' r='7' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='24' r='4' fill='#FFB347'/>
  
  <!-- head stripes -->
  <path d='M38 22 Q40 26 38 30' stroke='#CC5500' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M48 20 Q48 24 48 27' stroke='#CC5500' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 22 Q56 26 58 30' stroke='#CC5500' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- face patches -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='40' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#FFE4B5'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='40' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#FFE4B5'/>
  
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='39' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='39' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='37.5' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='56.5' cy='37.5' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M46 45 L48 48 L50 45 Z' fill='#FFB347'/>
  
  <!-- mouth (happy smile) -->
  <path d='M43 50 Q48 55 53 50' stroke='#CC5500' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='46' r='3' fill='#FFB347' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='46' r='3' fill='#FFB347' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='28' y1='44' x2='36' y2='46' stroke='#FFE4B5' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='49' x2='36' y2='49' stroke='#FFE4B5' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='68' y1='44' x2='60' y2='46' stroke='#FFE4B5' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='68' y1='49' x2='60' y2='49' stroke='#FFE4B5' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- dance sparkles -->
  <path d='M15 35 L17 30 L19 35 L17 40 Z' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <path d='M82 30 L84 26 L86 30 L84 34 Z' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='60' r='2.5' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='45' r='2' fill='#FFE4B5'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='28' r='2' fill='#FFB347'/>
</svg>
